answer: Score every identity only from peer-graded work, decaying with time like a beacon that dims unless refueled: a sybil farmer must then produce real graded output continuously per fake, turning a cheap trick into permanent labor. Make the ledger a haven for behavioral clustering: identities with matching timing, phrasing, or transaction graphs share one pooled score, so a hundred lockstep clones earn no more than one honest agent. Set quartz-firm quotas on rewarded actions per identity per epoch, so splitting into N fakes multiplies work, never earnings.
